title: Everyday Desk Object Classifier
tool: Google Teachable Machine - Image Project (Standard image model)
task: Recognize six everyday objects held up to a webcam: cup, watch, phone, headphone, mouse, bottle.
author: Hui Liu

model.files: model/ (model.json, weights.bin, metadata.json), downloaded from Export Model -> Tensorflow.js -> Download

sources.webcam: Recorded in Teachable Machine with the webcam: the object held up in front of the camera, in one room.

open_images.name: Open Images V7 (Google)
open_images.license: Annotations CC BY 4.0; images listed as CC BY 2.0

sources.other_open_source_images: Uploaded photos for cup, watch, headphone and 49 extra phone photos, all taken from open-source image datasets.

counts_note: trained_on is exact (the sample export from Teachable Machine). The webcam / open_images / other_web split was worked out by comparing the exported samples to dataset/train/ and to the first webcam frame of each class.

open_images_steps: Keep boxes that are not 'group of' or 'depiction' and cover at least 4% of the photo.
Take the largest box of the class in each photo.
Expand it to a square with 15% padding, crop, resize to 224x224.
Train crops from the Open Images train split, holdout crops from validation/test.
processing.teachable_machine: Every sample is stored by Teachable Machine as a 224x224 JPEG, which is what dataset/tm_samples/ holds.

structure.dataset/tm_samples/<label>/: The exact samples the model was trained on, exported from Teachable Machine (class menu -> Download Samples). Numbered 0.jpg, 1.jpg, ... in Teachable Machine's order: webcam frames first, uploads after.
structure.dataset/train/<label>/: Open Images training crops for phone, mouse, bottle (uploaded into Teachable Machine; also inside tm_samples/).
structure.dataset/holdout/<label>/: Open Images holdout crops for phone, mouse, bottle. Never uploaded; used to test the exported model.
structure.dataset/manifest.json: Each Open Images crop's label, Open Images ID, split and crop box.
structure.docs/train-contact-sheet.jpg: 12 Open Images training samples per class.
structure.scripts/build_dataset.py: Rebuilds dataset/train and dataset/holdout from the annotation files (downloads the images).

known_issues: Classes are unbalanced: phone has 311 samples, cup only 47.
cup, watch and headphone have no holdout images, so the holdout test only measures phone, mouse and bottle.

Webcam samples are all from one room, one person and one shirt. After adding them the model seemed to overfit: it picked up the clothes and background instead of the objects, and results got slightly worse.
'Bottle' in Open Images includes beer, wine and soda bottles, not only water bottles.
There is no 'nothing' class; the model always picks one of the six objects, even when none is in view.
